words.example: Calls to the enquiry desk are answered in business hours only.
words.exampleZh: 咨询台的电话只在工作时间内接听。

words.example: Visitors who arrive after hours must sign in with the night guard.
words.exampleZh: 下班后来访的人必须到夜班警卫处登记。

words.example: Thursday at noon is the cut-off for this month's overtime claims.
words.exampleZh: 本月加班申报的截止时点是周四中午。

words.example: A good lead-in for this item should stay under one minute.
words.exampleZh: 这个议题的开场铺垫最好控制在一分钟以内。

words.example: Once the chair signs, I will send everyone the wrap-up email.
words.exampleZh: 主持人一签字，我就把收尾邮件发给大家。

words.example: Queue wait on the main advice line passed four minutes during lunch.
words.exampleZh: 午餐时段，主咨询线的排队等待超过了四分钟。

words.example: We saw a call drop every time the handoff crossed from closet two to three.
words.exampleZh: 每次漫游从二号弱电间切到三号，我们都会看到通话中断。

words.example: The codec on the new phones does not match the old ward gateway.
words.exampleZh: 新话机的编解码和旧病区网关对不上。

words.example: Raise the jitter buffer slightly if ICU calls keep sounding broken.
words.exampleZh: 如果 ICU 的通话一直断断续续，就把抖动缓冲稍微加大。

words.example: QoS (Quality of Service) marks nurse-call traffic so a large file copy cannot drown it.
words.exampleZh: QoS（服务质量）给护士呼叫流量打标，大文件拷贝就不能把它淹没。
